neighborhoods.name: Farview & Arcola Section
neighborhoods.character: Historic estate section with rolling hills, custom colonials, and large lots bordering historic Arcola Country Club
neighborhoods.description: Historic residential neighborhood near the Saddle River, known for deep setbacks, mature trees, and prestigious residential architecture.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Enjoys ultra-low municipal tax rate (1.645% certified) due to Paramus's massive commercial retail tax base.

neighborhoods.name: Spring Valley & Century Section
neighborhoods.character: Suburban post-war split-levels and expanded bi-levels on generous 1/3-acre lots with quiet cul-de-sacs
neighborhoods.description: Family-centric neighborhood convenient to Paramus high-performing neighborhood elementary schools and community sports facilities.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Homeowners receive the 'Paramus Commercial Dividend'—subsidized municipal services from Garden State Plaza and Paramus Park retail ratables.

neighborhoods.name: West Paramus & Dunkerhook District
neighborhoods.character: Wooded residential setting adjacent to Saddle River County Park, offering walking trails, bicycle paths, and quiet suburban roads
neighborhoods.description: Scenic parkway-bordering neighborhood popular with outdoor enthusiasts, offering direct trail access into Ridgewood and Glen Rock.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Stable ratable base with robust market resale values.

neighborhoods.name: Route 4 & Garden State Retail Buffer Zone
neighborhoods.character: Suburban residences and modern condominiums buffered from major commercial corridors with excellent regional highway connectivity
neighborhoods.description: Mixed residential district convenient to retail shopping, medical complexes, and rapid transit buses into Manhattan.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Commercial ratable appeals (e.g. retail anchor reassessments) are closely monitored by borough assessors.

equityAnalysis.summary: Paramus Borough maintains a certified residential tax roll across its neighborhoods.

keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Paramus Borough, homeowners pay an average of $12,175.0 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 8.54% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 84.2%, assessed values average ~84.2% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 56.4% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 32.8%, and Bergen County claims 10.8%.
